canonical_source.title: MBP JIT PRUNING ENGINE — State Engineering Specification
canonical_source.author: Amul Bham

reconciliations: The Kernel 1.6 nine-type RKI registry remains authoritative over the source-era narrower vocabulary
JIT actions cover WEAKENS, CONVERGES_FROM, SYNTHESIZES, and active or resolved TENSIONS_WITH without collapsing their semantics
SUPPORTS and INHERITS_FROM are retired; FORKS_TO is import-only normalization to BRANCHES_TO
TRANSIENT remains deferred until DSS receives independent authority
Prompt runtime implements SOC-surface suppression and does not claim physical token eviction
Capsule schema remains v3.10 because JIT executes after seal and adds no capsule field
